versos.grego: Καὶ πάλιν ἤρξατο διδάσκειν παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν. καὶ συνάγεται πρὸς αὐτὸν ὄχλος πλεῖστος, ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς πλοῖον ἐμβάντα καθῆσθαι ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος πρὸς τὴν θάλασσαν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἦσαν.

controles.web: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea, and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.
controles.kjv: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
controles.livre: Jesus começou outra vez a ensinar junto ao mar, e uma grande multidão se ajuntou a ele, de maneira que ele entrou num barco e ficou sentado no mar; e toda a multidão estava em terra junto ao mar.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοὺς ἐν παραβολαῖς πολλά, καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ

controles.web: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,
controles.kjv: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
controles.livre: E ensinava-lhes muitas coisas por parábolas; e dizia-lhes em seu ensinamento:

versos.grego: Ἀκούετε. ἰδοὺ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ σπείρων σπεῖραι.

controles.web: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow,
controles.kjv: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
controles.livre: Ouvi: eis que o semeador saiu a semear;

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ σπείρειν ὃ μὲν ἔπεσεν παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν, καὶ ἦλθεν τὰ πετεινὰ καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτό.

controles.web: and as he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, enquanto semeava, uma parte das sementes caiu junto ao caminho, e os pássaros vieram, e a comeram.

versos.grego: καὶ ἄλλο ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὸ πετρῶδες ὅπου οὐκ εἶχεν γῆν πολλήν, καὶ εὐθὺς ἐξανέτειλεν διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν βάθος γῆς·

controles.web: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.
controles.kjv: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
controles.livre: E outra caiu em pedregulhos, onde não havia muita terra; e logo nasceu, porque não tinha terra profunda.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅτε ἀνέτειλεν ὁ ἥλιος ἐκαυματίσθη, καὶ διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν ῥίζαν ἐξηράνθη.

controles.web: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
controles.kjv: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
controles.livre: Mas, quando saiu o sol, queimou-se; e porque não tinha raiz, secou-se.

versos.grego: καὶ ἄλλο ἔπεσεν εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας, καὶ ἀνέβησαν αἱ ἄκανθαι καὶ συνέπνιξαν αὐτό, καὶ καρπὸν οὐκ ἔδωκεν.

controles.web: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
controles.kjv: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
controles.livre: E outra caiu entre espinhos; e os espinhos cresceram e a sufocaram, e não deu fruto.

versos.grego: καὶ ἄλλα ἔπεσεν εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν καλήν, καὶ ἐδίδου καρπὸν ἀναβαίνοντα καὶ αὐξανόμενα, καὶ ἔφερεν εἰς τριάκοντα καὶ ἐν ἑξήκοντα καὶ ἐν ἑκατόν.

controles.web: Others fell into the good ground, and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”
controles.kjv: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
controles.livre: Mas outra caiu em boa terra, e deu fruto, que subiu, e cresceu; e um deu trinta, outro sessenta, e outro cem.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγεν Ὃς ἔχει ὦτα ἀκούειν ἀκουέτω.

controles.web: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
controles.livre: E disse : Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο κατὰ μόνας, ἠρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ περὶ αὐτὸν σὺν τοῖς δώδεκα τὰς παραβολάς.

controles.web: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
controles.kjv: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
controles.livre: E quando Jesus esteve só, os que estavam junto dele, com os doze, perguntaram-lhe acerca das parábolas .

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ὑμῖν τὸ μυστήριον δέδοται τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ· ἐκείνοις δὲ τοῖς ἔξω ἐν παραβολαῖς τὰ πάντα γίνεται,

controles.web: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of the Kingdom of God, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
controles.livre: E respondeu-lhes: A vós é concedido o mistério do Reino de Deus; mas aos que são de fora, todas estas coisas se fazem por meio de parábolas;

versos.grego: ἵνα βλέποντες βλέπωσιν καὶ μὴ ἴδωσιν, καὶ ἀκούοντες ἀκούωσιν καὶ μὴ συνιῶσιν, μή ποτε ἐπιστρέψωσιν καὶ ἀφεθῇ αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: that ‘seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”
controles.kjv: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
controles.livre: para que vendo, vejam, e não percebam; e ouvindo, ouçam, e não entendam; para não haver de se converterem, e sejam perdoados .

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην, καὶ πῶς πάσας τὰς παραβολὰς γνώσεσθε;

controles.web: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Não sabeis o significado desta parábola? Como, pois, entendereis todas as parábolas?

versos.grego: ὁ σπείρων τὸν λόγον σπείρει.

controles.web: The farmer sows the word.
controles.kjv: The sower soweth the word.
controles.livre: O semeador semeia a palavra.

versos.grego: οὗτοι δέ εἰσιν οἱ παρὰ τὴν ὁδὸν ὅπου σπείρεται ὁ λόγος, καὶ ὅταν ἀκούσωσιν εὐθὺς ἔρχεται ὁ Σατανᾶς καὶ αἴρει τὸν λόγον τὸν ἐσπαρμένον εἰς αὐτούς.

controles.web: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes, and takes away the word which has been sown in them.
controles.kjv: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
controles.livre: E estes são os de junto ao caminho: nos quais a palavra é semeada; mas depois de a ouvirem, Satanás logo vem, e tira a palavra que foi semeada neles .

versos.grego: καὶ οὗτοί εἰσιν ὁμοίως οἱ ἐπὶ τὰ πετρώδη σπειρόμενοι, οἳ ὅταν ἀκούσωσιν τὸν λόγον εὐθὺς μετὰ χαρᾶς λαμβάνουσιν αὐτόν,

controles.web: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.
controles.kjv: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
controles.livre: E, semelhantemente, estes são os que se semeiam em pedregulhos: os que havendo ouvido a palavra, logo a recebem com alegria.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν ῥίζαν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἀλλὰ πρόσκαιροί εἰσιν, εἶτα γενομένης θλίψεως ἢ διωγμοῦ διὰ τὸν λόγον εὐθὺς σκανδαλίζονται.

controles.web: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.
controles.kjv: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended.
controles.livre: Mas não têm raiz em si mesmos; em vez disso, são temporários. Depois, quando se levanta a tribulação ou aperseguição por causa da palavra, logo caem.

versos.grego: καὶ ἄλλοι εἰσὶν οἱ εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας σπειρόμενοι· οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ τὸν λόγον ἀκούσαντες,

controles.web: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,
controles.kjv: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
controles.livre: E outros são os que se semeiam entre espinhos: os que ouvem a palavra;

versos.grego: καὶ αἱ μέριμναι τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἡ ἀπάτη τοῦ πλούτου καὶ αἱ περὶ τὰ λοιπὰ ἐπιθυμίαι εἰσπορευόμεναι συνπνίγουσιν τὸν λόγον, καὶ ἄκαρπος γίνεται.

controles.web: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
controles.kjv: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
controles.livre: mas as preocupações do mundo, a sedução das riquezas, e as cobiças por outras coisas, entram, sufocam a palavra, e ela fica sem gerar fruto.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐκεῖνοί εἰσιν οἱ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τὴν καλὴν σπαρέντες, οἵτινες ἀκούουσιν τὸν λόγον καὶ παραδέχονται καὶ καρποφοροῦσιν ἐν τριάκοντα καὶ ἐν ἑξήκοντα καὶ ἐν ἑκατόν.

controles.web: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”
controles.kjv: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
controles.livre: E estes são os que foram semeados em boa terra: os que ouvem a palavra, recebem-na, e dão fruto, um trinta, e outro sessenta, e outro cem.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι Μήτι ἔρχεται ὁ λύχνος ἵνα ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον τεθῇ ἢ ὑπὸ τὴν κλίνην; οὐχ ἵνα ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν τεθῇ;

controles.web: He said to them, “Is the lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Por acaso a lâmpada vem a ser posta debaixo de uma caixa ou sob da cama? Não deve ela ser posta na luminária?

versos.grego: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν τι κρυπτὸν, ἐὰν μὴ ἵνα φανερωθῇ· οὐδὲ ἐγένετο ἀπόκρυφον, ἀλλ’ ἵνα ἔλθῃ εἰς φανερόν.

controles.web: For there is nothing hidden, except that it should be made known; neither was anything made secret, but that it should come to light.
controles.kjv: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
controles.livre: Pois não há nada encoberto que não haja de ser revelado; e nada se faz para ficar encoberto, mas sim, para ser vir à luz.

versos.grego: εἴ τις ἔχει ὦτα ἀκούειν, ἀκουέτω.

controles.web: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”
controles.kjv: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
controles.livre: Se alguém tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Βλέπετε τί ἀκούετε. ἐν ᾧ μέτρῳ μετρεῖτε μετρηθήσεται ὑμῖν, καὶ προστεθήσεται ὑμῖν.

controles.web: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you, and more will be given to you who hear.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Prestai atenção ao que ouvis: com a medida que medirdes a vós mesmos se medirá, e será acrescentado a vós mesmos.

versos.grego: ὃς γὰρ ἔχει, δοθήσεται αὐτῷ· καὶ ὃς οὐκ ἔχει, καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: For whoever has, to him will more be given, and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”
controles.kjv: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
controles.livre: Pois ao que tem, lhe será dado; e ao que não tem, até o que tem lhe será tirado.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἔλεγεν Οὕτως ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὡς ἄνθρωπος βάλῃ τὸν σπόρον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς,

controles.web: He said, “The Kingdom of God is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,
controles.kjv: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
controles.livre: E dizia: Assim é o Reino de Deus, como se um homem lançasse semente na terra;

versos.grego: καὶ καθεύδῃ καὶ ἐγείρηται νύκτα καὶ ἡμέραν, καὶ ὁ σπόρος βλαστᾷ καὶ μηκύνηται ὡς οὐκ οἶδεν αὐτός.

controles.web: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, he doesn’t know how.
controles.kjv: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
controles.livre: e dormisse, e se levantasse, de noite e de dia, e a semente brotasse, e crescesse, sem que ele saiba como.

versos.grego: αὐτομάτη ἡ γῆ καρποφορεῖ, πρῶτον χόρτον, εἶτεν στάχυν, εἶτεν πλήρης σῖτος ἐν τῷ στάχυϊ.

controles.web: For the earth bears fruit: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
controles.kjv: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
controles.livre: A terra de si mesma frutifica, primeiro a erva, depois a espiga, depois o grão cheio na espiga.

versos.grego: ὅταν δὲ παραδοῖ ὁ καρπός, εὐθὺς ἀποστέλλει τὸ δρέπανον, ὅτι παρέστηκεν ὁ θερισμός.

controles.web: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
controles.kjv: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
controles.livre: E quando o fruto se mostra pronto, logo mete a foice, pois a colheita chegou.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἔλεγεν Πῶς ὁμοιώσωμεν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἢ ἐν τίνι αὐτὴν παραβολῇ θῶμεν;

controles.web: He said, “How will we liken the Kingdom of God? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?
controles.kjv: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
controles.livre: E dizia: A que assemelharemos o Reino de Deus? Ou com que parábola o compararemos?

versos.grego: ὡς κόκκῳ σινάπεως, ὃς ὅταν σπαρῇ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, μικρότερον ὂν πάντων τῶν σπερμάτων τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς,

controles.web: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,
controles.kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
controles.livre: Com um grão da mostarda que, quando semeado na terra, é a menor de todas as sementes na terra.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅταν σπαρῇ, ἀναβαίνει καὶ γίνεται μεῖζον πάντων τῶν λαχάνων, καὶ ποιεῖ κλάδους μεγάλους, ὥστε δύνασθαι ὑπὸ τὴν σκιὰν αὐτοῦ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνοῖν.

controles.web: yet when it is sown, grows up, and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”
controles.kjv: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
controles.livre: Mas, depois de semeado, cresce, e se torna a maior de todas as hortaliças, e cria grandes ramos, de maneira que os pássaros do céu podem fazer ninhos sob a sua sombra.

versos.grego: Καὶ τοιαύταις παραβολαῖς πολλαῖς ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον, καθὼς ἠδύναντο ἀκούειν·

controles.web: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
controles.kjv: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
controles.livre: E com muitas parábolas como essas Jesus lhes falava a palavra, conforme o que podiam ouvir.

versos.grego: χωρὶς δὲ παραβολῆς οὐκ ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς, κατ’ ἰδίαν δὲ τοῖς ἰδίοις μαθηταῖς ἐπέλυεν πάντα.

controles.web: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
controles.kjv: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
controles.livre: E não lhes falava sem parábola; mas aos seus discípulos explicava tudo em particular.

versos.grego: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὀψίας γενομένης Διέλθωμεν εἰς τὸ πέραν.

controles.web: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”
controles.kjv: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
controles.livre: Naquele dia, chegando o entardecer, disse-lhes: Passemos para o outro lado.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀφέντες τὸν ὄχλον παραλαμβάνουσιν αὐτὸν ὡς ἦν ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ, καὶ ἄλλα πλοῖα ἦν μετ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.
controles.kjv: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
controles.livre: Então despediram a multidão, e o levaram consigo assim como estava no barco; mas havia também outros barcos com ele.

versos.grego: καὶ γίνεται λαῖλαψ μεγάλη ἀνέμου, καὶ τὰ κύματα ἐπέβαλλεν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, ὥστε ἤδη γεμίζεσθαι τὸ πλοῖον.

controles.web: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.
controles.kjv: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
controles.livre: E levantou-se uma grande tempestade de vento; as ondas atingiam por cima do barco, de maneira que já se enchia.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν ἐν τῇ πρύμνῃ ἐπὶ τὸ προσκεφάλαιον καθεύδων· καὶ ἐγείρουσιν αὐτὸν καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε, οὐ μέλει σοι ὅτι ἀπολλύμεθα;

controles.web: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion, and they woke him up, and told him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”
controles.kjv: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
controles.livre: Jesus estava na popa dormindo sobre uma almofada. Então despertaram-no, e disseram-lhe: Mestre, não te importas que pereçamos?

versos.grego: καὶ διεγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τῷ ἀνέμῳ καὶ εἶπεν τῇ θαλάσσῃ Σιώπα, πεφίμωσο. καὶ ἐκόπασεν ὁ ἄνεμος, καὶ ἐγένετο γαλήνη μεγάλη.

controles.web: He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
controles.kjv: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
controles.livre: Então ele se levantou, repreendeu o vento, e disse ao mar: Cala-te, aquieta-te! E o vento se aquietou, e fez-se grande bonança.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τί δειλοί ἐστε οὕτως; πῶς οὐκ ἔχετε πίστιν;

controles.web: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?
controles.livre: E perguntou-lhes: Por que sois tão covardes? Como não tendes fé?

versos.grego: καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν φόβον μέγαν, καὶ ἔλεγον πρὸς ἀλλήλους Τίς ἄρα οὗτός ἐστιν, ὅτι καὶ ὁ ἄνεμος καὶ ἡ θάλασσα ὑπακούει αὐτῷ;

controles.web: They were greatly afraid, and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
controles.kjv: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
controles.livre: E ficaram muito atemorizados, e diziam uns aos outros: Quem é este, que até o vento e o mar lhe obedecem?
